Container.Name: immich-power-tools
Container.Overview:
Unofficial Immich client for advanced library management. Features include bulk people management, smart face merge, location enrichment, album discovery, library analytics, natural language search, and bulk date adjustment.
Connects to your Immich server via API and directly to the PostgreSQL database for advanced operations.
Must be on the same Docker network as immich-server and immich-vectorchord-db.
Container.Requires:
Requires immich-server and immich-vectorchord-db on the same Docker network (immich_internal). Create an API key in Immich with ALL permissions: Account Icon → Account Settings → API Keys → New API Key → Select All → Create.
Full setup guide: https://rorar.github.io/immich-unraid-manual/

Config.Name: Path: Data
Config.Description: Persistent data directory for Power Tools.

Config.Name: IMMICH_URL
Config.Description: Internal Immich server URL. Uses container name on immich_internal network.

Config.Name: IMMICH_API_KEY
Config.Description: Immich API key with ALL permissions. Create in Immich: Account Icon → Account Settings → API Keys.

Config.Name: --- Database ---
Config.Description: PostgreSQL connection. Must match your immich-vectorchord-db configuration.

Config.Name: DB_HOST
Config.Description: Database container name (must match your DB container on immich_internal).

Config.Name: --- Advanced (AI Search) ---
Config.Description: Optional: Enable natural language search via AI provider (OpenAI, Ollama, etc.). No personal data is sent - only search query text.

Config.Name: EXTERNAL_IMMICH_URL
Config.Description: External Immich URL for links in the Power Tools UI (e.g. https://photos.example.com). Leave empty to use IMMICH_URL.

Config.Name: AI_API_KEY
Config.Description: AI provider API key for natural language search (e.g. OpenAI key).

Config.Name: AI_BASE_URL
Config.Description: AI provider base URL. OpenAI: https://api.openai.com/v1, Ollama: http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1

Config.Name: AI_MODEL
Config.Description: AI model name. Examples: gpt-4o-mini, llama-3.1-8b-instant
